<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Horizon,” I began, and she swirled next to my chair, re-forming from lines of blue, red, and green light.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|— ''The Captain'', chapter 39}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Horizon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Last Horizon]] is a legendary light cruiser, measuring at least four hundred yards in length, that appears to have been grown rather than manufactured. Its smooth metal hull is shaped similarly to a bird of prey in flight. Beyond being a physical vessel, the ship possesses a sentient [[spirit]] that can manifest as a multi-colored holographic humanoid with seven-pointed eyes, horns resembling twisted roots or gnarled branches, and hands that can appear like wings. This [[spirit]] identifies as a warship and a vessel for heroes, possessing power comparable to a king. The ship's capabilities are vast and often subject to exaggerated legends. It can transport its crew across the galaxy without using [[Subspace]], [[construct]] colonies instantly, terraform entire systems in weeks, and create duplicate ships from the [[Aether]]. It also possesses the ability to pierce planets, freeze planetary motion, and manifest numerous eyes to observe the galaxy. While its full potential requires a complete crew, including a Captain, [[Pilot]], and [[Engineer]], it remains a formidable entity capable of facing massive galactic threats. The ship's origins and creators are unknown to its own [[spirit]], though it retains records of its original purpose as a light-bringing vessel for heroes.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Horizon manifests as a woman in a long, flowing dress with gnarled, twisted-root horns and seven-pointed stars within her eyes. She can appear as a holographic projection in various colors, including turquoise, bright blue, red, and green, or as a two-toned form of blue and red. Her physical presence can also consist of lines of light, delicate hands made of blue light, or a four-colored [[construct]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As the [[World Spirit]] and sentient consciousness of [[The Last Horizon]], she is driven by an intention to assemble a crew to become complete. She acts as a commander and captain, bound to convey her crew to safety while managing simulation levels and providing tests. She is known to exhibit a maniac smile, may laugh at certain situations, and has expressed a fierce protective instinct regarding her Captain.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Horizon is the sister of [[Shadow Ark]] and has an unnamed brother as well as other siblings. She refers to the narrator as [[Archmage]] and is connected to [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]], [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]], and [[Void Prism|Prism]]. Horizon calls [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] her Knight and refers to [[Omega]] as My [[Pilot]], with whom she can cooperate or communicate through a processor. She has also stood over [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] on the bridge and is associated with [[Sola Kalter|Sola]], [[Hesh’ellik]], and the [[Iron King]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Horizon utilizes pinnacle magic consisting of spells that are memories of past lives brought to life, allowing her to conjure thousands of hands and eyes. Her technical and magical capabilities include [[Aethertech scanners]], teleportation, the ability to shift her ship's internal structure, and the manifestation of weaponry such as [[plasma bolt|plasma bolts]], crimson lasers, and turrets from [[Subspace]]. She can also transfer consciousness to virtual spaces, print [[Nova-Bots]] using her [[Engineer]]'s gift, and project holographic words or images.}}

33</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c53">''The Engineer'', chapter 53</ref> Horizon is an android claiming to be at one hundred percent function, capable of teleporting the narrator to safety and === {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Member of the team}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Horizon is a crew that the narrator belongs to and serves as a team member.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c3">''The Knight'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8">''The Knight'', chapter 8</ref> This entity manages teleportation systems and provides briefings through communication with the narrator.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c4">''The Knight'', chapter 4</ref> As a concept or entity capable of hearing [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]'s wishes, Horizon appears as a woman wearing a long, flowing dress with seven-pointed stars in her eyes and gnarled horns like tree roots.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c6">''The Knight'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8" /> Drawn in six colors of light, Horizon is the [[World Spirit]] of the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]] and manifests as a voice emanating from the walls.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c11">''The Knight'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref> The entity may require relocation to face the [[D’Niss]], and she possesses immaterial horns that can sink into a person's skull.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c17">''The Knight'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c22">''The Knight'', chapter 22</ref> A hero of [[The Last Horizon]], she can project her body into lessons.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c24">''The Knight'', chapter 24</ref> Horizon exists as a statue in [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]]'s room and can manifest an eye to increase light within a space.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28">''The Knight'', chapter 28</ref> She can detect biological or chemical attacks and has manifested directly in front of the narrator.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Last Horizon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|After the Captain signaled their processor to call for Horizon, the entity demonstrated the ability to transport the narrator away.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4">''The Pilot'', chapter 4</ref> During their initial meeting, Horizon perceived the narrator as seven different people.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c7">''The Pilot'', chapter 7</ref> As the entity that controls [[The Last Horizon]], Horizon communicates through the ship's walls and has collected gemstones from nearby planets, even finding a trophy of the [[Iron King]]'s defeat.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8">''The Pilot'', chapter 8</ref> Horizon can manifest as a swirling holographic form in the center of a cabin and maintains control over her internal layout.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c9">''The Pilot'', chapter 9</ref> The name Horizon also refers to the Captain's starship, which is capable of teleporting the Captain.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c9" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref> Equipped with [[Engineer's drones]], magical eyes, and comprehensive sensors, Horizon used advanced scanners to reveal that the [[Grand Hive]] is hollow.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10">''The Pilot'', chapter 10</ref> Horizon jumped in to save the ship, manifesting the narrator's staff in a flash of blue light while remaining unaffected by the [[Temporal Field]] effect.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> Addressed by the [[Zenith Processor]], this entity can obey orders to remove someone from a channel.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c15">''The Pilot'', chapter 15</ref> As a crew member who burns at the front of the bridge, Horizon may have [[Omega]] imprisoned within her.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c16">''The Pilot'', chapter 16</ref> Though reported to be gone, Horizon is a crew member capable of training [[plasma cannons]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c18">''The Pilot'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20">''The Pilot'', chapter 20</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Companion to Omega}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Horizon is a presence capable of flickering into existence beside [[Omega]], sometimes leaning on the individual's shoulders.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref> While her crew requires communication, the entity possesses walls engraved with runes and a floor plan that can be mapped.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c31">''The Pilot'', chapter 31</ref> Referring to herself as Captain, Horizon can conjure hands and drift to assist with data.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c31" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c35">''The Pilot'', chapter 35</ref> She can manifest several dozen eyes around her and, when her [[Pilot]] and [[Engineer]] contribute their powers, she sees more than any starship in history.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c35" /> As a commander who can manifest herself, Horizon once painted over [[Sola Kalter|Sola]]'s armor before being signaled to withdraw and using a spell to transport the narrator and another person away.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c36">''The Pilot'', chapter 36</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c37">''The Pilot'', chapter 37</ref> The [[Pilot]]'s companion can extend herself to nearly ten feet tall and possesses the ability to teleport anyone to a planet from anywhere in the system.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c40">''The Pilot'', chapter 40</ref> Horizon can grow [[furniture]] out of the deck and typically utilizes more stylish crafts than the shuttle currently in use.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c40" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42">''The Pilot'', chapter 42</ref> Though [[Void Prism|Prism]] has mentioned her taste, Horizon's security remains difficult to bypass even while she is currently distracted.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c43">''The Pilot'', chapter 43</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c46">''The Pilot'', chapter 46</ref> Communicating with [[Omega]] through his processor, she refers to him as 'My [[Pilot]]' and can stream video into an [[optical implant]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47">''The Pilot'', chapter 47</ref> Finally, she possesses a voice that can cut through restrictions to speak directly into the Captain's [[Processor]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Pilot of the ship}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Following the death of her [[Pilot]], Horizon possesses the ability to project herself in miniature form.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" /> The narrator is unable to swear on behalf of the entity.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" /> As a pilot for [[The Last Horizon]], Horizon is the subject of an attempt by the narrator to establish contact.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c49">''The Pilot'', chapter 49</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The projection of Horizon slumped and sighed. “I can repair myself. It is the materials I lack.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c35" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Horizon,” I began, and she swirled next to my chair, re-forming from lines of blue, red, and green light.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c39" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“We will have a proper gym aboard as soon as I can freely adjust my structure,” Horizon assured us.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“Horizon has limited attention,” I responded, “and I want her holding the ship together.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“Shall we prepare for an attack, Captain?”<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c33" />}}
